snippet.description:
가을 제철 맞은 싱싱한 새우회🦐

en-US.description:
Fresh shrimp sashimi, perfect for fall!
One bite... and the taste immediately comes to mind!
A bowl of even more refreshing and invigorating shrimp soup noodles!

Now available in a packet!

The deep shrimp flavor is enhanced with powdered soup,
making the broth even more refreshing and clean!
Chewy noodles that soak up the broth and a generous amount of toppings are a given, right?

How about shrimp soup noodles for dinner tonight?
